caption: Bighorn ewe. Short, thin horns with only a slight curve. Pale rump patch.
author: USFWS Mountain Prairie

caption: Mature bighorn ram in winter. Heavy brown horns curling back, down and forward toward a full circle.
author: YellowstoneNPS
cardBack: Bighorn ram. Heavy curled horns, brown body, white rump. Ram classes and curl rules: see the Rule Book.

caption: Dall sheep ram, head close up. All white, with pale amber horns that flare out to the side.
author: Jacob W. Frank
cardBack: Dall sheep ram. All white body, pale flaring horns. In BC only in the far northwest.

caption: Stone's sheep ram on rock. Dark grey brown body, white rump and belly, curled amber horns.
author: Jack Bindernagel
cardBack: Stone's sheep ram. Dark body, white rump, belly and leg backs. Northern BC.

caption: Young Stone's sheep ram. Horns curve back but are still short of a big curl.
author: Thompson Hyggen

caption: Mountain goat. White shaggy coat, short black horns, beard on the chin.
author: Forest Service Alaska Region, USDA
cardBack: Mountain goat. White coat, short black dagger horns, beard. Not a sheep: sheep have curled brown or amber horns.

caption: Mountain goat nanny with her kid on a cliff top. A nanny with a kid at her side is easy to spot.
author: Yellowstone National Park, USA by Diane Renkin
